body:
alex_cs: Heads-up 10am sync request from CareAxis security. They want: SOC2 scope for embeddings, whether embeddings contain raw PHI, and deletion guarantees. Need an internal answer for the customer call at 3pm.

nina_security: Short answers for the call: (1) SOC2 covers our hosted control plane and storage services (see SOC2 report section 3.2); (2) embeddings are not stored with raw PHI fields in cleartext; (3) deletion requests are supported via support request with audit trail for hosted customers, and via tenant tooling for Dedicated/Private. I'll expand if you want wording.

devin_prod: Quick technical notes: embeddings indexed in object store (encrypted) + metadata table (tenant_id, hashed_user_id). We never persist the original plaintext prompt beyond 7 days in ephemeral logs (used for debugging) unless customer turns on extended logging. Backups/snapshots include encrypted blobs; deletion triggers a tombstone + background scrub job that clears index pointers and schedules blob GC within 72 hours.

sam_engineer: To add: hashed_user_id = HMAC_SHA256(salt_per_tenant, user_id). Salt is generated per-tenant and stored in KMS-wrapped key store. For Dedicated/Private we can use customer KMS. Re-identification risk is low but not zero; recommend we state that embeddings are pseudonymized and cryptographically protected, not irreversibly anonymized.

alex_cs: Can we get a one-paragraph statement for the call + a 3-item FAQ? i'll paste on the customer screen during the meeting.

nina_security: Draft: "Redwood stores embeddings in encrypted storage and associates only tenant-scoped, pseudonymized identifiers (HMAC with per-tenant salt). Plaintext prompts are not retained long-term. Deletion requests are fulfilled with audit evidence; Dedicated/Private customers have additional self-service tooling. See attached SOC2 section references and deletion runbook excerpt."

devin_prod: I'll attach the runbook excerpt and a sample deletion proof (sanitized).

ops-bot: CS ticket CS-4991 created (owner: alex_cs)

alex_cs: Perfect. Sending to CareAxis now. Will log any follow-ups here. :thumbsup:

sam_engineer: If they ask about embedding similarity attacks, we should offer an eval: we can run their example dataset through a risk check on a short-term staging index. I can own that if they want.

alex_cs: Noted. I'll ask during call if they'd like the eval.

ops-bot: Reminder: customer call 3pm UTC today (CareAxis) added to CS-4991

alex_cs: Closing thread for now; will reopen with minutes from the call.
